key_insight: PneuGen uses collaborating LLM agents and simulation feedback to efficiently co-design soft pneumatic robots for specified tasks.
engineering_relevance: The framework helps engineers explore coupled geometry, morphology, material, and actuation choices for task-specific soft robots.
method: A designer agent proposes design programs using a parametric component library.
Fitted module response models supply physical priors linking geometry and pressure to deformation.
Automated validation and finite-element simulation generate diagnostics that a critic agent uses to recommend revisions.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports significant gains over computational optimisation baselines on grasping and planar/3D shape matching, ablation support for both the critic and response models, and real-world demonstrations.
watch_item: Performance beyond the tested tasks remains uncertain, and broader use may require additional component models and simulation validation.
paper_title: PneuGen: Task-Driven Agentic Co-Design of Soft Pneumatic Robots
